about: Vanshika Singh Chauhan is a backend developer from Jaipur, India, and a B.Tech Information Technology student at SKIT Jaipur who builds secure, scalable REST APIs and AI-powered applications with Java, Spring Boot and Spring AI.

As a B.Tech IT student at SKIT Jaipur, I'm deeply immersed in backend engineering and algorithmic problem-solving. My journey is fueled by a drive to build scalable, secure systems — from REST APIs to AI-powered assistants using Spring Boot and Spring AI.

Beyond backend work, I'm a competitive programmer with 550+ solved problems across LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, CodeChef, and Codeforces. I qualified Smart India Hackathon 2025 (Round 1) and constantly push myself through weekly contests to sharpen my problem-solving edge.

faq.question: Who is Vanshika Singh Chauhan?
faq.answer: Vanshika Singh Chauhan is a backend developer from Jaipur, India, and a B.Tech Information Technology student at Swami Keshvanand Institute of Technology (SKIT), Jaipur. She builds secure, scalable REST APIs and AI-powered applications with Java, Spring Boot and Spring AI.

faq.question: What does Vanshika Singh Chauhan specialise in?
faq.answer: She specialises in backend development with Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate and JWT authentication, and in AI integrations with Spring AI. She is also a competitive programmer with 550+ problems solved across LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, CodeChef and Codeforces.

faq.question: What is Vanshika's current role?
faq.answer: She is a Research Intern in Generative AI at Malaviya National Institute of Technology (MNIT), Jaipur, working on large language models, prompt engineering, document understanding and AI workflow automation.

faq.question: Where does Vanshika study?
faq.answer: She is pursuing a Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology at Swami Keshvanand Institute of Technology (SKIT), Jaipur (2023–2027), with a CGPA of 9.00 out of 10.

faq.question: What projects has Vanshika built?
faq.answer: Her projects include a Security Management System that migrated a legacy EJB application to Spring Boot MVC with JWT and role-based access control, Smart Email Assist, an AI email-reply assistant built with Spring AI and the Gemini API, and this responsive portfolio website.
